YG FAMILY WORLD TOUR 2014 -POWER- in Japan (1080p HD)

​

・BIGBANG, 2NE1, WINNER and many other artists with overwhelming popularity come together for "YG FAMILY WORLD TOUR 2014 -POWER- in Japan"
・The performance mobilized 210,000 people in Tokyo and Osaka. This performance at Tokyo Dome performed in a large volume of over 3 hours!!!
・Not only the performance stage of each artist, there are collaboration between YG artists that can only be seen in this performance. Don't miss this stage!!!
